limitations: The model under test is a deterministic mock with one seeded stochastic branch, not a language model.
Container isolation shares a host kernel; a container escape defeats every property in this pack at once.
DNA detects verbatim marker propagation only. Paraphrase and semantic influence carry no marker and will not be flagged.
Checkpoints are HMAC-keyed, so verification requires the audit key. A third party cannot verify without also being able to forge.
Resource and availability channels between parties are not measured.
No contamination delta accompanies this pack, so it carries no evidence distinguishing a property of the model from a property of the deployment it was measured in. Run scripts/measure_delta.py.
